ja.source: Wikipedia 日本語版「イエローピタヤ」
ja.text: イエローピタヤ は、サボテン科セレニケレウス属の多年生着生植物（エピファイト）。南アメリカ北西部の熱帯地域を原産地とする。果実の経済的価値が高く、広く栽培されている。なお、果皮が赤い赤ピタヤ とは別種である。

en.text: Selenicereus megalanthus, synonym Hylocereus megalanthus, is a cactus species in the genus Selenicereus that is native to northern South America, where it is known, along with its fruit, by the name of pitahaya. The species is grown commercially for its yellow fruit, but is also an impressive ornamental climbing vine with perhaps the largest flowers of all cacti.

en.heading: Cultivation
en.text: This is an easily cultivated, fast-growing plant. It needs a compost containing plenty of humus, and sufficient moisture in summer. It should not be kept in temperatures under 8 °C (46.5 °F) in winter. It can be grown in semi-shade, but it does best in full sunlight. Extra light in the early spring stimulates budding. The plant flowers in June to October. The plant can grow to a very large size.
